A '''stormtrooper''' was stationed onboard the [[Death Star/Legends|''Death Star'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]]. Upon receiving an alert, he was leading a squad of stormtroopers to search for the rebels.
